paracetamol.name: Paracetamol / Acetaminophen
paracetamol.warning: Risk of severe liver damage if combined with other products containing Paracetamol (e.g., Dolo, Crocin, Calpol).

ibuprofen.name: Ibuprofen
ibuprofen.warning: Risk of gastrointestinal bleeding or kidney strain if combined with other NSAIDs (e.g., Advil, Brufen).

aspirin.name: Acetylsalicylic Acid (Aspirin)
aspirin.warning: Do not combine with other blood thinners or NSAIDs without medical supervision.
